_meta.description: Stage-2 validation targets for the mainnet replica. One entry per row of topology_metrics.py's TABLE_ROWS, keyed by metric_key. Each carries the literature point-estimate (S1-S11) AND, where a crawl can observe it, our own 2026-09-23 measurement (S13), so the replica is scored against the best available target with its provenance visible.
_meta.regenerate: measured_2026 values are transcribed from crawl/report.json; re-run analysis/mainnet/{crawl,poll,enrich_asn,summarize}.py and re-transcribe if the crawl is repeated.
_meta.verdict_kinds: point (|measured-value|<=tolerance_abs), range ([lo,hi] inclusive), min (>=value), max (<=value), info (no pass/fail: value is scenario-dependent or n=1).

_context.note: S13 findings that reconcile the design assumptions but do not map onto a per-node replica metric. Recorded here as the measured baseline's context.

reachability_of_probed.detail: 18026 reachable / 39885 probed IPs. NOT the same denominator as general.reachable_fraction (share of ACTIVE nodes accepting inbound, literature ~0.15): most unreachable probed IPs are stale/NAT peerlist entries. Do not set reachable_fraction from this number.

spy_fleet.dominant_asn: AS401476 (SCNL-1-0001 - Spruce Creek Networks LLC, US)
spy_fleet.detail: VALIDATES the design assumption of clustered spies in dense /24s within a single ASN. The replica places real-node spies (variant R) in dense /24s (topology_node 828-833) -- this is the mainnet analog, scaled down.  peer-id-mismatch alone labels 0.686; the ban list labels 0.737; support-flags-absent only 0.032 (few proxies omit flags in 2026).

honest_prefix_top12pct_share.validates: network.distribution.prefix_sharing.fraction (currently 0.31) -- measured 0.308 of honest nodes in the top 12% of /24s. Good match; no change indicated.

honest_geography.detail: Regionally ~NA 0.66 / EU 0.20 / asia ~0.03 / oceania ~0.01 (top-10 countries; tail unshown). The scenario's weights (north_america 58 / europe 30 / asia 9 / oceania 3) run EU high and NA low vs this. Candidate scenario retune, NOT a topology_metrics target. Note: DigitalOcean AS14061 alone holds 0.446 of honest nodes -- hosting-provider concentration the region weights don't capture.

conn_duration_our_node.detail: One LAN node, small n (28 out / 35 in). Connection-duration + >6h tail are OUT OF SCOPE for topology_metrics.py (see its docstring); validated separately with analysis/ruck_analysis_turnover.r. Recorded for cross-reference: median ~18min out / ~10min in is in the ballpark of the topology study's ~23min.

measured_2026.method: A crawl observes peerlists, not each node's actual outbound connection count; outbound-degree distribution is not externally measurable. Literature retained.

top_share.label: Connection share held by top 13.2% of nodes (total degree)

measured_2026.method: top_13_2pct_edge_share of the peerlist-adjacency graph (who lists whom), n=39484. CAVEAT: a peerlist graph is far more even than the connection graph S1 measured (everyone lists ~150 peers), so this is NOT comparable to the 83% connection-graph target and must not replace it. Shown to document that the connection graph cannot be reconstructed from peerlists.

hub_coverage.label: Hub coverage (share of non-hub nodes adjacent to a hub)

measured_2026.method: hub_coverage_top14 on the peerlist-adjacency graph: share of nodes with a top-14-by-peerlist-degree node among their peerlist entries. CAVEAT: peerlist-degree hubs are not S2's connection-count supernodes, and peerlist adjacency is not the connection graph; not comparable to the 82% target. Retained literature.

inbound_per_reachable.label: Inbound connections per reachable honest node

measured_2026.method: inbound median of our single LAN node over 48 poll ticks (day 1 of 7). n=1 node: one node's inbound depends on its uptime/advertisement, so this is a weak reference below the S10 band, not a retarget. The 7-day poll may raise it.

spy_inbound.label: Spy share of honest inbound slots

measured_2026.method: REGIME CHANGE. Our ban-list-defended LAN node saw 0% spy inbound; but the crawl finds 73.7% of REACHABLE IPs are the Spruce Creek fleet, so an UNDEFENDED node's inbound would be spy-dominated. The replica's actual spy inbound share is a function of how many reachable spies it places (a stage-3 design choice), so no hard pass/fail here.

spy_outbound.label: Spy share of honest outbound slots

measured_2026.method: 0% at our defended node. Scenario-dependent (spy placement); no hard pass/fail. See spy_inbound regime note.

spy_peerlist.label: Spy share of peerlist entries (observer dumps)

measured_2026.method: 0% in our defended node's white/gray lists; 73.7% of network reachable IPs are spies. Scenario-dependent; no hard pass/fail. See spy_inbound regime note.
